Instead, we can replace Mockito usage with simple stubs or manual implementations. Simpler: remove Mockito imports and usage, and instead create simple mock implementations manually using anonymous classes.

We need to adjust test code to not rely on Mockito. Also ValidationContext constructor signature mismatched: expects (URIFactory, URNFactory, JsonMetaSchema, JsonSchemaFactory, SchemaValidatorsConfig). In test they passed nulls plus config, but also passed extra null. The constructor expects 5 args, they gave 6. Let's check signature: According to dependent class list, ValidationContext has fields: URIFactory, URNFactory, JsonMetaSchema, JsonSchemaFactory, SchemaValidatorsConfig. So constructor likely (URIFactory, URNFactory, JsonMetaSchema, JsonSchemaFactory, SchemaValidatorsConfig). So we should call new ValidationContext(null, null, null, null, config). Remove extra null.

Also anyOfValidator constructor: AnyOfValidator(String schemaPath, JsonNode schemaNode, JsonNode parentSchema, ValidationContext ctx). In code they passed "anyOfTest", anyOfArray, null, validationContext. That's fine.

Need to replace Mockito usage: @Mock fields and @ExtendWith(MockitoExtension) can be removed. Instead of injecting mocks via reflection we can directly set fields in AnyOfValidator (schemas list, discriminatorContext). For DiscriminatorContext we can create a simple implementation of the interface (inner class) returning true.

We need to know the types: ValidationContext.DiscriminatorContext is an inner class. We can create a stub class implementing required methods: isDiscriminatorMatchFound(). Possibly other methods but only used in AnyOfValidator.validate. Let's inspect AnyOfValidator code (not provided). But we can guess that it checks discriminatorContext != null and .isDiscriminatorMatchFound(). So stub with that method.

Similarly JsonSchema interface: we need to create simple stub that returns predetermined values for methods: hasTypeValidator(), getTypeValidator(), validate(...). We'll create a custom class implementing JsonSchema with fields for behavior.

But many tests need to create multiple mock schemas with different behavior. Could create a simple MockJsonSchema class where we can set booleans and return sets.

Simplify: Use lambda via java.lang.reflect.Proxy? Could use Mockito but not allowed. We'll implement a simple class.

Define class SimpleJsonSchema implements JsonSchema {
   private boolean hasType;
   private TypeValidator typeValidator;
   private Set<ValidationMessage> validationResult;
   // constructors etc.
   // implement methods needed: hasTypeValidator(), getTypeValidator(), validate(...). Others can throw UnsupportedOperationException.

We need to know JsonSchema interface methods. Not provided. But we can approximate: at least hasTypeValidator(), getTypeValidator(), validate(ExecutionContext, JsonNode, JsonNode, String). Return Set<ValidationMessage>.

Also maybe getSchemaNode? Not needed.

Implement only those methods.

Similarly ValidationMessage interface: we need to mock getMessage() and getType(). We'll implement a simple class SimpleValidationMessage implements ValidationMessage { private String message; private String type; ... }

But tests only use getMessage() for remark detection, and getType() for checking error types. So implement both.

Also TypeValidator interface: methods getSchemaType(), equalsToSchemaType(Object). We'll implement simple stub.

DiscriminatorContext interface: method isDiscriminatorMatchFound(). We'll implement stub.

Thus we can remove all Mockito imports and annotations.

We'll also need to adjust imports.

Let's write corrected test code.

We'll keep config, mapper static.

We'll remove @ExtendWith(MockitoExtension.class) and @Mock fields.

We'll create helper methods to create stub schemas.

Implement SimpleJsonSchema with constructor taking Set<ValidationMessage> result, boolean hasTypeValidator, TypeValidator typeValidator.

Implement SimpleValidationMessage with message and type.

Implement SimpleTypeValidator with JsonType schemaType and boolean match.

Implement SimpleDiscriminatorContext with boolean matchFound.

Now adjust test methods: Instead of mock(...), use new SimpleJsonSchema(...). For error messages we can create new SimpleValidationMessage("msg1","type1").

Also need anyOfValidator.injectSchemas: we still use reflection to set private field schemas.

DiscriminatorContext injection: use reflection to set field.

Now adjust imports: remove Mockito imports.

Also remove static imports of Mockito.

Now compile.
